import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Define paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv")
test_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv")
sample_submission_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission_null.csv")

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

# Get exact column order from sample submission template
expected_columns = list(sample_submission.columns)


# Clean and normalize comments - lowercasing improves feature consistency
def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        text = text.lower()  # Normalize case
        text = re.sub(r"http\S+|www\S+|https\S+", "", text)  # Remove URLs
        text = re.sub(r"@\w+", "", text)  # Remove mentions
        text = text.strip()
        return text
    return ""


# Apply cleaning for training only
# CRITICAL FIX: Keep ORIGINAL test comments for submission
train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text).fillna("")
test_df_clean = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text).fillna("")
test_df_original = test_df["Comment"].copy()  # Preserve exact original for submission
test_df_dates = test_df["Date"].copy()  # Preserve dates for submission

# Separate features and target
X_train_full = train_df["Comment"]
y_train_full = train_df["Insult"]
X_test = test_df_clean

# Split training data into training and validation sets
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

# Initialize Word-level TF-IDF vectorizer
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=5000, min_df=2, analyzer="word"
)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Initialize Character-level TF-IDF vectorizer
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(2, 3), max_features=5000, min_df=1, analyzer="char_wb"
)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Concatenate features (Word + Char)
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Train Logistic Regression model
model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42)
model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Calculate AUC-ROC on validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Clip predictions to [0,1] range for robustness
y_test_pred = np.clip(y_test_pred, 0.0, 1.0)

# Create submission file matching required format exactly
# CRITICAL: Use ORIGINAL test comments (not cleaned) in submission
# Columns must be in exact order from sample submission template
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": test_df_original,
        "Date": test_df_dates,
        "Insult": y_test_pred.astype(np.float64),
    }
)

# Reorder columns to exactly match sample_submission template
submission_df = submission_df[expected_columns]

# Verify submission format
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Expected shape: ({len(test_df)}, {len(expected_columns)})")
print(f"Column order: {list(submission_df.columns)}")
print(f"Expected column order: {expected_columns}")
print(f"Test rows: {len(test_df)}, Submission rows: {len(submission_df)}")

# Save submission - PRESERVE PREVIOUS SOLUTION'S FILE-WRITING CODE EXACTLY
submission_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")

# Final verification
print(
    f"Submission saved to {submission_path} with {len(submission_df)} rows and columns: {list(submission_df.columns)}"
)
